title: Metric requirements
description: What a cluster needs before it exports each group of metrics.

metrics.description: Metric family names, or patterns with * for any run of characters.

property.description: Name of a cluster configuration property.

value.description: The value the property must have.

condition.description: A state the cluster must be in, as one plain sentence. AsciiDoc inline markup is allowed. Name a configuration property as prop:<name>[link=true], so the docs link it, never in backticks.

releases.description: The release lines this requirement holds for. Leave it out when it holds for every release. A requirement outside its range is not written into that release's dataset and is not reported as out of date.

from.description: The first release line it holds for, as major.minor. For example 26.2.

before.description: The first release line it no longer holds for, as major.minor.

evidence.description: measured: the metrics were absent without this state and present with it on a real cluster. source: read from the Redpanda source, not measured.
